language_task: Pick up the spoon and place it into the box.
outcome_evidence: The robot acquires the spoon by its handle and lifts it clear of the table (frames 41–48, wrist_left and ceiling), then carries it to the blue box and lowers it inside (frames 53–70, ceiling and wrist_right). The gripper opens, leaving the spoon resting in the box (frames 71–77, wrist_right). The spoon remains inside after the arm withdraws through frame 95 (ceiling). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
